forbidden: shoes that contradict the sticky-swamp shoe gag unless deliberately kept simple and childlike

wardrobe.description: Large dog-sized friendly dragon with warm expressive eyes and a soft terracotta ribbon tied as her signature accessory; the ribbon stays terracotta throughout and should read as fabric, not metal.

hairStyle.value: medium-length, worn loose in a simple everyday style

anchors.description: Low bed with rumpled bedding where the child can sit and think.
Wooden toy chest that can open into a purple-glowing magical portal.
Area with small baby items: a tiny bottle, tiny socks, and the small yellow blanket.
Clear floor space between bed, toy chest, and baby corner; important for the final feeling that everyone has room.

locations.description: A warm, lived-in bedroom where the child's bed, toy chest, and a small baby-care corner share the same cozy room. The space begins feeling crowded with tiny baby things, then later feels more open and breathable.
locations.lighting: soft warm household light, gentle shadows, calm bedtime tones
locations.name: Home bedroom with baby corner
locations.topology: The bed sits along one wall; the toy chest is close enough for the child to reach from the bed area; the baby corner is visible across the room. The final pages use the same geometry but with more visible open space.

anchors.description: Open orange hill where the child lands and first meets Dini.
Soft nest in the middle of a hilltop, sized for the green speckled egg.
Rounded slope leading from the nest area down toward the swamp.
Sticky purple swamp at the bottom, glossy and gooey, making comic plup sounds.
Safe soft hill-bank near the swamp edge where the egg can be tended with the silver cloth ribbon.

locations.description: A tender fantasy landscape of rounded orange hills at dusk, with a central nest, a rolling slope, and a sticky purple swamp at the bottom. Everything should feel plush, safe, and storybook-soft rather than dangerous.
locations.lighting: lavender-orange dusk glow with soft rim light and no harsh shadows
locations.name: Dini's soft orange hills
locations.topology: Arrival hill connects to the nest hilltop; the nest hilltop rolls down into the downhill slope; the slope ends at the purple swamp edge and soft bank. Pages should preserve this left-to-right/downhill relationship.

recurringProps.description: A familiar wooden toy chest whose interior can glow purple and open like a small window between home and the fantasy hills.
recurringProps.material: warm-toned wood with magical purple light inside when open
recurringProps.name: wooden toy chest portal
recurringProps.persistence: Closed or ordinary when not active; active on pages 2 and 15, then calm/closed by page 16.
recurringProps.scale: child-sized chest, large enough to visually imply a portal but still a bedroom object

recurringProps.description: A small soft yellow blanket associated with the baby; first part of the crowded baby things, later used as a gentle open hug.
recurringProps.name: small yellow blanket
recurringProps.persistence: Visible in the home on page 1, used on page 15, remains around the baby on page 16.

recurringProps.description: Small bottle and tiny socks that make the bedroom feel full of new baby objects.
recurringProps.name: tiny baby things
recurringProps.persistence: Important on page 1 as background context; may remain subtle in later home pages.

recurringProps.description: Green egg with dark spots, about the size of a small cushion; it moves, rolls, cracks, and hatches.
recurringProps.material: smooth eggshell with painted storybook speckles
recurringProps.name: green speckled dragon egg
recurringProps.persistence: Whole in pages 5-8, lightly cracked pages 9-12, hatching on page 13, shell no longer the focus on page 14.
recurringProps.scale: about the size of a small pillow

recurringProps.description: Plush nest at the center of the hill, cozy and rounded rather than twiggy or sharp.
recurringProps.material: soft mossy fibers and cushion-like grasses
recurringProps.name: soft dragon nest
recurringProps.persistence: Foreground on pages 5-6; implied origin point once the egg rolls away.
recurringProps.scale: large enough to hold the cushion-sized egg

recurringProps.description: A soft silver fabric ribbon used to make a loose protective boundary around the egg, explicitly not metal.
recurringProps.name: silver cloth ribbon
recurringProps.persistence: Introduced page 11, wrapped loosely around egg pages 12-13, may rest nearby after hatching.
recurringProps.scale: long enough to wrap loosely around the egg with a visible opening

recurringProps.description: A small harmless stone knocked over by Dini's jumpy tail during the bell moment.
recurringProps.name: small knocked stone
recurringProps.persistence: Only important on page 4; should not become a hazard.
